test_title: PYST 31: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

The old man asked the boy where the postman was.

options.text: The old man says to the boy, “Where is the postman?”
The old man said to the boy, “Where has been the postman?”
The old man said to the boy, “Where is the postman?”
The old man said to the boy, “Where was the postman?”

solution:
The correct answer is **The old man said to the boy, “Where is the postman?”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in** Indirect Speech**. We need to change it into <
